params.body:
The repository is private, so a shields.io release badge cannot read it (it renders "repo not found"). The README gets a static badge instead, pointing at the latest release, and a small workflow keeps it honest: on every published GitHub release it rewrites the badge to the release tag and commits that one line to `main` as github-actions[bot]. Nothing happens when the badge already carries the tag.

Starts at v2.0.0, the release published today. The `sed` was tried against the current line with a fake tag; the workflow itself runs for the first time at v2.1.0.
params.title: README: release badge, kept current by a workflow
